artefacts.note: The 96 types' direction / inverse_of declarations, mechanically extracted from the v2 payload's schema_front. Consumed as DATA by the batch path: the JF-F1 symmetric set is read from this artefact through the profile's pair_judge_symmetric_source key (stage 11, W-1/W-2). Not a prompt surface.

candidates.note: Authored-definitions payload. Not adopted: the stage-4 pilot that priced it ran under configurations the fitting line later corrected, and its counted ceilings sit below the v1 payload's measured rates. Adoption only via a registered gate in a future pack version; the bytes stay in the repo. Its direction declarations ARE in force as emission data via direction_declarations.json (this manifest's artefacts list).

contents_index.entity_inventory: DocRED's 6 entity types (PER / ORG / LOC / TIME / NUM / MISC) with definitions and form examples, carried from profile v1; v2 adds one audit-grounded extraction prohibition: demonym adjectives are never LOC endpoints (stage-2 audit, Set B malformed-gold species).
contents_index.merge_prohibitions: MP-1: never merge entities of different schema types (carried from v1).
contents_index.metadata_declarations: Per-run parameter declarations mirrored in the payload (triple_threshold 0.25, review_band 0.25-0.50, er_threshold 0.40, er_cross_doc_min_p_same 0.85, embed_model, batch_cost_cap_usd, provider_sort). Declarations, not live values — BatchConfig governs the run (docs/PACK_DESIGN.md §3).
contents_index.relation_directionality: schema_front declares 'directed': DocRED relations hold in the annotated direction. 3 of 96 types are declared symmetric per type (spouse, sister city, sibling); 7 inverse pairs (14 entries) are declared via inverse_of. The declarations are materialized as direction_declarations.json and are IN FORCE as emission data: the JF-F1 pair judge's symmetric set is read from that artefact (pack 0.2.0). father / mother / child carry no inverse_of — a recorded gap in the artefact, not filled by invention. The guidance RENDERING of directionality remains candidate (the renderer's fixed undirected line is a registered defect until the rendering is fitted).
contents_index.relation_inventory: All 96 DocRED relations. Each entry: an authored definition (anchored on the Wikidata property the label denotes — rel_info.json P-id — and on train-gold usage), a train-derived modal endpoint signature with its coverage share and other attested patterns (signature_note), a direction declaration, an inverse_of pointer where the inventory contains the inverse, and an extraction_intent for the confusable clusters (inverse pairs, containment cluster, date cluster, creator cluster, whole/part non-transfer).

convention_notes.note: Dev gold contains world-knowledge triples not stated in the released text (concentrated in located-in / country / present-in-work): measured pair support 0.5859 on the stage-2 audit sample (58/99). Exact-match recall against this gold is capped near 0.59 at pair level; recall is therefore reported against the judged-supported denominator (the main-run design, §3).

Gold occasionally uses a demonym adjective as a LOC cluster's only mention (e.g. 'Russian' as the tail of a located-in triple) — malformed under any convention. The pack's extraction side prohibits demonym endpoints; the scoring side does not credit them.

Gold-side cluster splitting exists (7/49 sampled mentions, stage-2 audit step 3) but barely damages triple-level recall under surface matching: stage-3 decomposition bucket (f) = 1 of 1,098 misses. Recorded so a future entity-level measurement on this corpus inherits the warning.
Dev/test gold received two revision rounds, train one (Re-DocRED paper). Scoring is dev-only, permanently; train is the fitting side for definitions, signatures, and examples.

Renamed pre-release (2026-10-22): pack id 'general-documents' / display 'General Documents' -> 'open-domain' / 'Open Domain'. The old name collided with the 'General' baseline pack (itself renamed 'Core'): the baseline is a layer, this pack is the open-domain (general prose) domain. Manifest identity and internal paths were updated and the version bumped; the payload, candidate, and artefact bytes — and their pins — are unchanged.

payload.note: In force. The fitted production configuration (stages 4c-12) runs on the v1 payload: the full v1 guidance is the extraction surface the fitting line adopted (J5s0/J3F/J3F2 all rejected; the v2 payload's cost ceilings sit below v1's, so v2 was never priced in the corrected configuration). Promotion binds the v1 bytes by this pin, per the main-run design (section 6).
